metadata.title: Relay | Expand into any market with the right partners
metadata.description: Relay helps businesses expand globally by connecting them with vetted partners and service providers — before a partnership mistake costs a year.

banner.text: 240+ partners mapped across collections, payouts, banking, FX, KYC and cards.

position.title: New markets shouldn't mean irreversible partnerships.
position.lede: Uncertainty about who to trust. Options you never see. Mistakes that take a year or two to unwind. Relay puts partners and service providers in front of you before you commit.

quote.text: We almost signed a payout partner we couldn't unwind for eighteen months. Relay showed us three better options in a day.

footer.tagline: Infrastructure intelligence for the people building financial products.
footer.disclaimer: Relay is an infrastructure directory and introduction service. Listed fees, settlement times and coverage are indicative, compiled from provider documentation and builder reports, and may change without notice. Relay is not a payment institution and does not provide financial, legal or regulatory advice.
